components.usage: Root safe-area container with optional scroll, pull-to-refresh, keyboard avoidance, and tab-bar clearance.
components.antiUse: Do not nest a scrolling Screen inside another ScrollView or FlatList.

components.usage: Spring press-scale feedback wrapper with optional native haptics. Pass containerStyle={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }} inside flex rows.
components.antiUse: Do not omit containerStyle when placing multiple AnimatedPressables in equal-width rows.

components.usage: Primary, secondary, outline, ghost, and danger actions with loading and icon slots.
components.antiUse: Do not use more than one primary Button competing in the same footer.

components.usage: Elevated, outlined, muted, or gradient container for cohesive grouped content.
components.antiUse: Never nest Cards inside Cards or repeat identical icon+title+text Cards for an entire screen.

components.usage: Compact semantic status pill (accent, success, warning, danger, neutral).
components.antiUse: Never use Badge as a decorative eyebrow above every page heading.

components.usage: Selectable category or filter pill inside horizontal strips or wrap rows.
components.antiUse: Avoid more than 6 chips without horizontal scrolling.

components.usage: 2-to-4 option mutually exclusive view or timeframe switcher (e.g., Day/Week/Month, Buy/Sell).
components.antiUse: Avoid more than 4 segments or long multi-word labels on 390px screens.

components.usage: Clean section heading with optional concise subtitle and right-aligned action.
components.antiUse: Do not add numbered prefixes unless sequence order carries meaning.

components.usage: Compact KPI tile with tabular numerals and optional delta badge.
components.antiUse: Do not stack more than 2–4 StatTiles without a focal hero or visualization.

components.usage: Animated circular progress meter with centered metric or custom child slot.
components.antiUse: Do not use decorative progress rings that do not reflect real user data.

components.usage: Smooth tabular-nums counter for balances, scores, distances, and live KPIs.
components.antiUse: Do not animate static labels or dates.

components.usage: Accessible text field with label, leading/trailing icon slots, focus accent, and inline validation.
components.antiUse: Never rely on placeholder text alone when a label clarifies field purpose.

components.usage: Purposeful zero-data state with icon/artwork slot, crisp explanation, and clear CTA.
components.antiUse: Never leave a blank screen when a list or search result is empty.

components.usage: Focused dismissible modal sheet for detail previews, filters, or quick actions.
components.antiUse: Do not use a modal sheet for flows that belong on a dedicated stack screen.

components.usage: Floating pill bottom navigation bar sized cleanly for 2–4 top-level tabs.
components.antiUse: Avoid 5+ tabs inside FloatingTabBar; use native-tabs for 5 destinations or compact titles.

components.usage: Restrained loading placeholder matching final content geometry.
components.antiUse: Do not use generic full-screen spinners when skeleton geometry communicates layout better.

components.usage: Subtle staggered fade-and-lift entrance wrapper honoring reduced-motion accessibility.
components.antiUse: Do not wrap every single tiny element on screen; limit to key top-level sections or list items.
